articles.title: More on the pending oversight hearings: State of Crypto
articles.snippet: New letters show the widening range of Congressional committees that will be probing the presidential administration — and the crypto collateral that may be swept up.

articles.title: Bitcoin's quantum security challenge extends to bridges, custodians and millions of coins
articles.snippet: Quantum computers can’t break Bitcoin network’s security yet, but Leo Fan warns that upgrading it and moving funds could take longer than expected.

articles.title: Cross-chain protocol Chainflip's FLIP tanks 30% after suspected $4.86 million vault drain
articles.snippet: The withdrawal carried a valid signature, which Onchain Lens said points to a possible compromise of the key validators use to approve vault payouts.

articles.title: OpenAI, Anthropic and rivals seek AI agent rules to prevent commerce chaos
articles.snippet: OpenAI, Anthropic, and other technology giants are backing standards designed to enable agents to work together without putting any one company in control.

articles.title: Ether treasury firm BTCS warns SEC its $54 million Aave loan could be liquidated
articles.snippet: BTCS cut its reported Aave debt by about $10 million in ten days, but falling ether prices are keeping its collateral under pressure.
